EventTouch Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		1. Overview
	

The EventTouch dataset belongs to Haptic Sensing Lab at the School of Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics, Peking University. The EventTouch dataset contains data from tactile-sensor contact experiments and finite element method (FEM) simulations. It includes sensor outputs, contact forces, nodal displacements, and experimental parameters collected for different objects, contact poses, and press depths.
